title: Up (2009 film)
blurb: A large, flightless, brightly colored bird who befriends Carl and Russell in Pixar's Up — revealed late in the film to be female.
facts: Along the way, they befriend a talking dog as well as an exotic bird and encounter Carl's childhood idol Charles Muntz, who has sinister plans to capture the bird.
creators: Pixar Animation Studios (Pete Docter, Bob Peterson)
